notes.title: Deja Vu : The Backrooms | Jobs & Photos
notes.content:
[h1]Jobs & Photos[/h1]

Deja Vu : The Backrooms now introduces a [i]secondary objective[/i] alongside collecting all memory fragments to escape. Players can take on [b]jobs[/b] that reward them for capturing unique scenes and features of the Backrooms environment. Completing these tasks [b]earns money[/b], which can be used to [b]purchase items[/b] that aid in navigating the Backrooms or to participate in a [i]gambling minigame[/i].

[h2]Taking Photos[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417303/7bec3a44d32f51c8591b3c9f72a5f4514cc7bb78.png[/img]

[b]The camcorder[/b] now has the ability to [b]capture photos[/b] in addition to its night vision feature. These photos can be viewed, validated for jobs, or deleted on a [b]special computer in The Loop[/b]. Whether you’re completing a job or simply capturing a beautiful scene or a teammate, the camcorder proves to be an invaluable tool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417303/d7c888bae9c704b3eda933bcf7c59aa05559edda.png[/img]

[h2]Jobs[/h2]

The [b]job system[/b] can also be accessed through the [b]special computer in The Loop[/b]. Each level offers a set of jobs, along with some that can be completed in any level. Jobs come with a [b]variety of requirements[/b]—for example, some may require multiple photos, while others might demand several items captured within a single image. Upon returning to The Loop, players can [b]claim their rewards[/b] and [b]review their captured photos[/b] using the special computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417303/f7e527c4eccbd9ad1a78c5bf2cf200e44067a4d2.png[/img]

[h2]Item Shop[/h2]

The Lobby now features a shack where players can spend their money to [b]purchase items[/b] that aid them in the level. For example, instead of searching for a camcorder, you can buy one in advance, or stock up on almond water to maintain your stamina during encounters with entities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417303/a605ddaf4126066b3410ffdd8cbd27ca2312967f.png[/img]

[h2]Slot Machine[/h2]

In The Loop, players can also use a [b]slot machine[/b] to spend their money, with the chance to [b]win even more.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417303/adc868298aebe464ebb83a9b2727834cf3b3dbaa.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed and adjusted various net-code issues.
[*] Fixed faulty HUD referencing on the client side.
[*] Fixed a save issue where the client’s inventory data was not being saved.
[*] Polished and refined 3D menu interactions.
[*] Improved and adjusted camcorder functionality.
[*] Other minor bug fixes and polishing.
[/list]

[i]PS : I have thoroughly tested this version, including all multiplayer features, and haven’t encountered any additional bugs. However, this doesn’t guarantee that it’s completely bug-free. If you come across any issues, please report them in the dedicated discussion on the community hub or on the Discord server![/i]

notes.title: Multiplayer Update v1.2.5 | 1-4 Co-op
notes.content:
Deja Vu : The Backrooms now supports 1-4 player co-op mode, expanding from the previous two-player limit. This change was made based on feedback from many players who suggested that a 1-4 player option would enhance the experience.

[i][b]Change Log[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with pushable objects getting stuck.
[*] Enhanced chase hallucination visual and sound effects (VFX & SFX).
[*] Resolved issues with entity target selection.
[*] Improved and optimized NetCode for better performance.
[*] Polished pickup and interaction animations.
[*] Fixed other various minor bugs and glitches.
[/list]

[i]PS: This version may be unstable and could contain bugs. If you encounter any issues, please report them in the discussions thread or the discord server. Thank you![/i]
